name: seowebchecker
description: Real-time technical SEO linter for HTML, JSX, TSX, Astro, Vue, Svelte, and Markdown. Detects missing alt tags, duplicate H1s, title/meta lengths, and OpenGraph issues.

commands.title: SEOWebChecker: Run Technical SEO Audit on Current File
SEOWebChecker: Open Visual SEO Audit Panel
SEOWebChecker: Export SEO Report as Markdown
SEOWebChecker: Export SEO Report as JSON

seowebchecker.minTitleLength.description: Minimum recommended characters for title tag (default: 30).

seowebchecker.maxTitleLength.description: Maximum recommended characters for title tag before search truncation (default: 60).

seowebchecker.minDescriptionLength.description: Minimum recommended characters for meta description (default: 70).

seowebchecker.maxDescriptionLength.description: Maximum recommended characters for meta description snippet (default: 160).

seowebchecker.checkHeadings.description: Validate H1 presence and flag duplicate H1 tags.

seowebchecker.checkImages.description: Flag images missing alt text or using redundant alt descriptions.

seowebchecker.checkLinks.description: Check external links with target="_blank" for rel="noopener noreferrer".

seowebchecker.checkOpenGraph.description: Check for og:title and og:image social cards.

seowebchecker.checkCanonical.description: Validate presence of canonical link tags.

seowebchecker.checkMobileViewport.description: Ensure mobile viewport meta tag exists and user zooming is not disabled.

seowebchecker.checkThinContent.description: Warn when full pages contain very thin content (< 300 words).

seowebchecker.minWordCount.description: Minimum word count threshold for full content pages.

seowebchecker.enableStatusBar.description: Show live SEO score and diagnostic status in the VS Code status bar.

seowebchecker.enableHover.description: Show SEO character counter and tips when hovering over tags.
